name: myuhe/org-toodledo
description: Latest release 2.1.0 brings in some good fixes, support for subtasks and https for secure transactions. Revamped org-toodledo based on the 2.0 API from Toodledo.com.  I started with the latest from Sacha's branch, but ended up rewriting a good portion of it as I went...  This version is working at least on Emacs running native on Windows 7.
